cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before congratulating the winner, apologise for starting me behind the shed.

mechanism: Copy a runner's crouch as a starting cue, then demand an apology recognizing the competitive disadvantage of following it.
confusable: Not a justified complaint about an official start: B2 shows a shoelace action was mistaken for a signal and A refuses to own that confusion.
comparison: Shared missed start differs from a cake's delayed judging.
seedUse: Retains race disadvantage and demand for specific apology; replaces the shed with a copied shoelace crouch.
